blurb: Guests take private scenic flights over New Orleans in small airplanes, seeing landmarks like the Mississippi River, French Quarter, and Superdome. They can also participate in discovery flights with hands-on flight instruction. Tours are customizable and include options with champagne, chocolate, and romantic packages.
